Lacking a military solution against Iran, Trump turns to economic suffocation
subhead: As midterm elections approach, the Trump administration is favoring economic pressure over military involvement, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announcing Monday some 60 new Iranian entities, individuals and ships have been added to the sanctions list. Tehran in turn denounced 'economic terrorism.'

title: Europeans condemn Russia's campaign of terror in Ukraine
subhead: Meeting with Volodymyr Zelensky on Monday, August 24, for a Coalition of the Willing conference, European leaders reiterated their military and financial support for Kyiv and denounced Russia's intensifying strikes on civilian infrastructure.

title: 'The hens suffocated': Fewer, smaller eggs are the double effect of France's scorching summer
subhead: Episodes of extreme heat have exposed stark differences in how well poultry farms are equipped to adapt, with up to 2% of the country's laying hens dying during the June heatwave alone. Beyond excess mortality, the heat also reduces egg production and results in smaller eggs, causing further losses for farmers.

title: 'Citizens no longer trusted us': Belgium's attempt to revive democracy
subhead: 'Room for Hope' (1/6). High voter abstention, unfulfilled political promises and the growing influence of authoritarian movements have weakened democracies. In response to this crisis, Belgian writer David Van Reybrouck is behind numerous initiatives that hope to reinvigorate democratic practice.

title: Venezuelan photographer Silvana Trevale's captivating photos of joy amidst the 'whirlwind of collapse'
subhead: 'Youth in hostile environments' (5/7). After fleeing crisis-stricken Venezuela, Silvana Trevale has regularly returned to photograph the country's youth – capturing the carefree moments of boys and girls who, despite a lack of prospects, embody the vital spirit of Venezuelan society.

title: Haruki Murakami: 'Writing struck me completely unexpectedly, like a lightning bolt from a clear sky'
